title: Publish {{file}}
description: Visitors see the version you publish, read only. Your comments and the thread stay private.
linkFailed: Couldn't open this file's link. Please try again.
privateHint: Only you can open the link.
privateWithVersions: Not shared. Its versions are kept, and publishing again uses the same link.
sharedHint: Anyone with the link can open it.
upToDate: Visitors see v{{seq}}. Nothing has changed since.
changedSince: Changed since v{{seq}}. Visitors see v{{seq}} until you update.
legacyRefused: Visitors can't open this link until you update it.
keepUpdatedHint: Publish a new version at the end of each turn that changes the file. Files it starts using wait for your Update.
filesChanged: The file changed while this was open. Review the list and publish again.
driftAdded_one: {{count}} new file waits for Update. Visitors won't get it until you update.
driftAdded_other: {{count}} new files wait for Update. Visitors won't get them until you update.
rootRefs: This page loads files from the site root, such as <path>{{example}}</path>, which visitors won't get. Build it with relative paths, for example with <cmd>vite build --base=./</cmd>.
notSharedDetail: It isn't in the published version yet. Publishing shares it.
leftOutDetail: It won't be published, so visitors can't open it.
leftOutFailed: Couldn't change that file. Try again.
listFailed: Couldn't list the files this one references.
tooManyFiles: This file references more than {{limit}} files, which is more than a link can carry.
overCapLeaveOut: Leave out files below until it fits.
tooManyBytes: The files this one references add up to more than {{size}}, which is more than a link can carry.
missing: This file is no longer in the workspace.
unavailable: The file can't be read right now. Try again shortly.
needsComputer: This page uses files that are only on the running computer. Start the computer, then publish.
unchanged: Nothing changed since v{{seq}}, so no new version was made.
label: Note
labelPlaceholder: Optional, shown in the version list
changeFailed: Couldn't change sharing. Please try again.
